_comment: WG-9: Node resolves a .js file's module system from the nearest package.json up the tree. A consumer product app's repo-root package.json with "type":"module" (ESM) would otherwise make Node treat every MC framework script and hook under scripts/ as ESM, breaking `require` across the whole layer (partly silently — hooks fail-open). This file pins scripts/ to CommonJS regardless of what the product root declares. Do not delete. Adding a package.json here does not stop node_modules resolution (which walks dirs independently), so framework deps still resolve from the repo-root node_modules.
